cards.back:
To watch something carefully.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengamati
Example: We observe the plant each day and write notes.
cards.say: observe. To watch something carefully. We observe the plant each day and write notes.

cards.back:
To say what you think will happen.
Bahasa Indonesia: memprediksi
Example: I predict the ice will melt in the sun.
cards.say: predict. To say what you think will happen. I predict the ice will melt in the sun.

cards.back:
To find out the size, weight or amount of something.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengukur
Example: Measure the string with a ruler.
cards.say: measure. To find out the size, weight or amount of something. Measure the string with a ruler.

cards.back:
Facts that show something is true.
Bahasa Indonesia: bukti
Example: The wet ground is evidence that it rained.
cards.say: evidence. Facts that show something is true. The wet ground is evidence that it rained.

cards.back:
What you decide after looking at the results.
Bahasa Indonesia: kesimpulan
Example: Our conclusion was that plants need light.
cards.say: conclusion. What you decide after looking at the results. Our conclusion was that plants need light.

cards.back:
A thing you can change in an experiment.
Bahasa Indonesia: variabel
Example: The amount of water was the variable we changed.
cards.say: variable. A thing you can change in an experiment. The amount of water was the variable we changed.

cards.back:
To change from a liquid into a gas.
Bahasa Indonesia: menguap
Example: Water will evaporate when it is heated.
cards.say: evaporate. To change from a liquid into a gas. Water will evaporate when it is heated.

cards.back:
To change from a gas into a liquid.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengembun
Example: Steam will condense into drops on cold glass.
cards.say: condense. To change from a gas into a liquid. Steam will condense into drops on cold glass.

cards.back:
To change from a solid into a liquid.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencair
Example: Ice cream starts to melt in the sun.
cards.say: melt. To change from a solid into a liquid. Ice cream starts to melt in the sun.

cards.back:
To change from a liquid into a solid because of cold.
Bahasa Indonesia: membeku
Example: Water will freeze in the freezer.
cards.say: freeze. To change from a liquid into a solid because of cold. Water will freeze in the freezer.

cards.back:
To mix into a liquid and disappear.
Bahasa Indonesia: larut
Example: Sugar will dissolve in warm water.
cards.say: dissolve. To mix into a liquid and disappear. Sugar will dissolve in warm water.

cards.back:
A material that keeps its shape.
Bahasa Indonesia: padat
Example: A stone is a solid, not a liquid.
cards.say: solid. A material that keeps its shape. A stone is a solid, not a liquid.

cards.back:
A material that flows and takes the shape of its container.
Bahasa Indonesia: cair
Example: Milk is a liquid that we pour into a glass.
cards.say: liquid. A material that flows and takes the shape of its container. Milk is a liquid that we pour into a glass.

cards.back:
A material that spreads out to fill the space it is in.
Bahasa Indonesia: gas
Example: Air is a mixture of gases.
cards.say: gas. A material that spreads out to fill the space it is in. Air is a mixture of gases.

cards.back:
The power to do work or make things happen.
Bahasa Indonesia: energi
Example: The sun gives us light and heat energy.
cards.say: energy. The power to do work or make things happen. The sun gives us light and heat energy.

cards.back:
A push or a pull.
Bahasa Indonesia: gaya
Example: A strong force is needed to move the heavy box.
cards.say: force. A push or a pull. A strong force is needed to move the heavy box.

cards.back:
A force that slows things moving across each other.
Bahasa Indonesia: gesekan
Example: Friction between the tyre and the road helps cars stop.
cards.say: friction. A force that slows things moving across each other. Friction between the tyre and the road helps cars stop.

cards.back:
An object that pulls some metals, such as iron, towards it.
Bahasa Indonesia: magnet
Example: The magnet picked up the metal pins.
cards.say: magnet. An object that pulls some metals, such as iron, towards it. The magnet picked up the metal pins.

cards.back:
A complete path that electricity flows around.
Bahasa Indonesia: rangkaian listrik
Example: The bulb lit up when we closed the circuit.
cards.say: circuit. A complete path that electricity flows around. The bulb lit up when we closed the circuit.

cards.back:
All the bones in a body.
Bahasa Indonesia: kerangka
Example: A skeleton holds up your body and protects it.
cards.say: skeleton. All the bones in a body. A skeleton holds up your body and protects it.

cards.back:
A part of the body that helps you move.
Bahasa Indonesia: otot
Example: Your leg muscle helps you kick the ball.
cards.say: muscle. A part of the body that helps you move. Your leg muscle helps you kick the ball.

cards.back:
An animal that hunts other animals for food.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemangsa
Example: The lion is a predator on the grassland.
cards.say: predator. An animal that hunts other animals for food. The lion is a predator on the grassland.

cards.back:
An animal that is hunted for food.
Bahasa Indonesia: mangsa
Example: The rabbit is prey for the fox.
cards.say: prey. An animal that is hunted for food. The rabbit is prey for the fox.

cards.back:
The remains of a plant or animal from long ago, found in rock.
Bahasa Indonesia: fosil
Example: We found a shell fossil in the stone.
cards.say: fossil. The remains of a plant or animal from long ago, found in rock. We found a shell fossil in the stone.

cards.back:
To carry pollen from one flower to another.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyerbuki
Example: Bees pollinate flowers while they collect nectar.
cards.say: pollinate. To carry pollen from one flower to another. Bees pollinate flowers while they collect nectar.
